headline: LOK SABHA SPEAKER EXTENDS GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF GANESH CHATURTHI
fullText:
Lok Sabha Secretariat

LOK SABHA SPEAKER EXTENDS GREETINGS ON THE EVE OF GANESH CHATURTHI

13 SEP 2026 8:30PM by PIB Delhi

Lok Sabha Speaker Shri Om Birla has extended greetings on the eve of Ganesh Chaturthi. In his message Shri Birla has said,

"Heartiest greetings on the sacred occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi, the auspicious festival dedicated to the worship of Lord Shri Ganesha, the Remover of Obstacles and the Bestower of Auspiciousness.

I pray to Lord Shri Ganesha to remove all obstacles and difficulties from everyone’s life and bless all with happiness, peace, prosperity and good health. May His divine blessings infuse renewed energy into our resolve towards the progress of the nation and the welfare of the people.

On this sacred occasion, let us resolve to move forward on the path of knowledge, wisdom and harmony.

With a spirit of universal brotherhood, may we seek the well-being, prosperity and auspiciousness of all at the feet of Gajanan, the First-Worshipped One.

Ganpati Bappa Morya"

(Release ID: 2309921)

headline: Prime Minister congratulates Indian Women’s Cricket Team on winning Asia Cup
fullText:
Prime Minister's Office

Prime Minister congratulates Indian Women’s Cricket Team on winning Asia Cup

14 SEP 2026 8:45AM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi, has congratulated the Indian Women’s Cricket Team on winning the Asia Cup.

The Prime Minister said that the team’s confidence, consistency and remarkable spirit were on full display throughout the tournament.

Shri Modi expressed hope that this triumph would inspire millions of youngsters across the country to play more and shine.

In a post on X, Shri Modi said;

“A proud moment for Indian cricket!

Congratulations to the Women’s team on winning the Asia Cup. Their confidence, consistency and remarkable spirit were on full display throughout the tournament.

May this triumph inspire millions of youngsters across the country to play more and shine.”

A proud moment for Indian cricket!

May this triumph inspire millions of youngsters across the country to play more…

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 14, 2026

(Release ID: 2309934)

headline: Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam on Ganesh Chaturthi, seeks blessings of Lord Ganesha
fullText:
Prime Minister's Office

Prime Minister shares Sanskrit Subhashitam on Ganesh Chaturthi, seeks blessings of Lord Ganesha

14 SEP 2026 8:41AM by PIB Delhi

The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has extended his heartfelt greetings to all citizens on the auspicious occasion of Ganesh Chaturthi. He expressed the hope that the sacred festival of worshipping and seeking the blessings of Vighnaharta, Lord Ganesha, would infuse everyone’s lives with new energy and enthusiasm. Shri Modi prayed that, with the divine blessings of Lord Ganesha, everyone’s efforts would succeed and the nation would continue to progress on the path of development.

The Prime Minister shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam-

“मुदाकरात्तमोदकं सदा विमुक्तिसाधकं

कलाधरावतंसकं विलासिलोकरक्षकम्।

अनायकैकनायकं विनाशितेभदैत्यकं

नताशुभाशुनाशकं नमामि तं विनायकम्॥”

The Subhashitam conveys that I bow to Lord Shri Vinayaka, whose sacred hands are adorned with modakas; who forever guides seekers on the path of liberation; who wears the crescent moon as an ornament upon his forehead; who is the protector of the entire universe and the sole supreme lord of the cosmos; who vanquished the demon Gajasura and who swiftly frees his devotees from all sorrows and afflictions.

The Prime Minister wrote on X;

“देशवासियों को गणेश चतुर्थी की अनंत शुभकामनाएं। विघ्नहर्ता के दर्शन और पूजन का यह पावन पर्व सबके जीवन में नई ऊर्जा और नए उत्साह का संचार करे। उनके दिव्य आशीर्वाद से सभी के प्रयास सफल हों और राष्ट्र निरंतर प्रगति के पथ पर आगे बढ़ता रहे, यही कामना है। गणपति बाप्पा मोरया!

मुदाकरात्तमोदकं सदा विमुक्तिसाधकं

देशवासियों को गणेश चतुर्थी की अनंत शुभकामनाएं। विघ्नहर्ता के दर्शन और पूजन का यह पावन पर्व सबके जीवन में नई ऊर्जा और नए उत्साह का संचार करे। उनके दिव्य आशीर्वाद से सभी के प्रयास सफल हों और राष्ट्र निरंतर प्रगति के पथ पर आगे बढ़ता रहे, यही कामना है। गणपति बाप्पा मोरया!… pic.twitter.com/5biHnkWHJ4

— Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 14, 2026

(Release ID: 2309933)
summaryText:
### OVERVIEW
The Prime Minister of India, Shri Narendra Modi, extended Ganesh Chaturthi greetings on 14 September 2026, shared a Sanskrit Subhashitam, and prayed for Lord Ganesha’s blessings to bring success to individual efforts and continued progress for the nation.

### KEY HIGHLIGHTS
- Date and time of announcement: 14 SEP 2026 at 8:41 AM (IST)  
- Release ID: 2309933  
- Platform: Post on X (Twitter) by @narendramodi  
- Shared content: Sanskrit Subhashitam verse  
  - Verse: “मुदाकरात्तमोदकं सदा विमुक्तिसाधकंकलाधरावतंसं विलासिलोकरक्षकम्। अनायकैकनायकं विनाशितेभदैत्यकं नताशुभाशुनाशकं नमामि तं विनायकम्॥”  
  - Meaning conveyed: Bow to Lord Vinayaka whose hands hold modakas, who guides seekers to liberation, wears the crescent moon, protects the universe, is the supreme lord, defeated demon Gajasura, and swiftly removes devotees’ sorrows.  
- Greeting message: Wished citizens infinite greetings, hoped the festival would infuse new energy and enthusiasm, prayed that divine blessings would make all efforts succeed and the nation would continue progressing on the path of development.  
- Included traditional chant: “गणपति बाप्पा मोरया!”
